metadata.alt_text: An overlaid histogram of edit counts of top 2,000 users and the 1,105 gender-inferred users. The top 2,000 users contributed  95.36% of all no-bots edits. The gender-identified users are equally distributed across the top 2,000 users in terms of edit counts.
